g.text: Fresh and fast, or one of the two
Each engine and consistency mode at 560,497 relationships. Lower left is better.
longest time a revoked permission was still granted, over 90 races
NodusDB in process: never stale, 9 microseconds
NodusDB follower given the write's token: never stale,
10 microseconds; a check right after that write waits
about 140 ms for it to arrive
NodusDB follower without a token: up to 0.3 s stale
its default: up to 3.5 s stale
check cache on: 10 s stale every time
AuthzBench, 2026-11-07: two c5.2xlarge in eu-north-1, each service on its own Postgres, 30 races per mode at each of three scales.
